# Whofy

> Whofy is a resume-first job matching platform. Users upload their resume and get a ranked shortlist of live job openings matched to their skills, experience, and location in under a minute.

## How it works
1. Upload a PDF or DOCX resume
2. Whofy parses skills, experience, and education using AI (Groq)
3. Matches against 20,000+ live job openings from 9 sources
4. Delivers a ranked shortlist with match scores and skill explanations

## Key features
- No sign-up required to find jobs
- Resume is parsed in-memory and never stored
- Supports freshers and senior professionals
- Job listings refreshed daily, full database updated every 28 days
- Save jobs for later with a free account (Google sign-in)

## Data sources
Greenhouse, Lever, RemoteOK, Adzuna, Ashby, Workday, Hacker News, Himalayas, We Work Remotely
